# Support & Communication

Welcome to the StaffPurse community! If you need help, have architectural questions, or want to discuss a Wave issue, please reach out to us:

*   **Discord:** [Join the StaffPurse Discord](https://discord.gg/5aprtMSyR) (Primary for architectural discussions & PR reviews)
*   **Telegram:** [Join the StaffPurse Telegram](https://t.me/+Gflo5jZStw1jMjE0) (Primary for quick questions and Drips Wave coordination)

**Important:** Please do not use GitHub Issues for general support questions. Issues are reserved for actionable bug reports and feature requests.
